name: Microgrid storage state-of-charge availability
summary: Qualifies the reported battery state of charge with its assigned health and freshness conditions.
description: Qualifies the reported battery state of charge with its assigned health and freshness conditions. Storage coordination combines the battery's energy limits with the converter's electrical capability and the microgrid's operating demand. State of charge, allowable power and connection status describe different aspects of availability.

In a microgrid with a battery energy storage system, the controller can request discharge to support a power deficit while the battery management and conversion systems enforce their own operating limits. For this reference, the drawing identifies “State of charge and quality” at the input and “Usable charge-state information” at the output. State of charge is an estimate.
